conversations.value: How does Lamark keep nightly SFT from overwriting important prior behavior?
It uses anti-forgetting guards, especially the forgetting-probe diagnostics before promotion. That makes sure the new adapter does not regress protected behaviors before it is approved.
Why can’t `lamark-core` depend on any other workspace crate?
Because `lamark-core` is the base layer for shared types, traits, and IDs, so it must stay dependency-free within the workspace.
Where do Lamark training datasets get posted after they are built?
They are posted to knowledge-base at POST /knowledge/datasets.
Fill in the blank: Lamark's DGX Spark LoRA stack requires `torchao` version ________.
A developer wants Lamark to respond inside Slack. Which component is involved?
lamark-gateway, using the Slack adapter.
Match the crate to its responsibility: skill loader and bundled skill handling.
`lamark-skills`.
What minimum `torchao` version should Lamark require for the DGX Spark LoRA stack?
Which of these is more Lamark-friendly and why: `if ok { if ready { start(); } }` or `if ok && ready { start(); }`?
`if ok && ready { start(); }` is more Lamark-friendly because it collapses the nested `if`.
What does it mean that Lamark is bidirectional in MCP?
It means Lamark can both consume external MCP servers and expose its own tools through an MCP server interface.
I want to inspect rollout bundles. Which `lamark trace` subcommands are mentioned?
`lamark trace` supports reduce, list, and show for rollout bundles.
A Lamark test currently checks five fields one by one on a returned struct. What testing style is preferred instead?
Prefer deep equality over field-by-field assertions: compare the whole object with `assert_eq!` when possible.
What should Lamark do if the user switches from Bedrock to a local vLLM server?
It should keep the same ModelProvider-based runtime and change configuration to point at the new provider, including the appropriate base_url and context_length if needed.

In Lamark, why is this pattern discouraged?

```rust
let result = items.into_iter().filter(|x| predicate(x)).collect::<Vec<_>>();
```
Because a method reference is preferred when it exists. If `predicate` can be passed directly, use that instead of an unnecessary closure.
List the memory providers Lamark supports in this layer.
Lamark supports knowledge-base, Honcho, Mem0, Hindsight, and SQLite as a local fallback.
Describe Lamark's implementation language and runtime focus.
Lamark is written in Rust from day one, with a Python training pipeline for the learning side.
What are the two ACP components mentioned in the spec?
An ACP registry and an ACP adapter.
What is the purpose of `trace.jsonl` in the rollout bundle?
It is the append-only event log for the session, capturing the structured trace as JSON Lines.
A crate wants to terminate the process on fatal error. Is `std::process::exit` allowed?
No. Layers must return `Result`; only the binary decides the exit code.

Add every enum variant explicitly, for example:

match provider {
    Provider::OpenAI => start_openai(),
    Provider::Anthropic => start_anthropic(),
    Provider::Local => start_local(),
    Provider::Bedrock => start_bedrock(),
}
Describe what happens when a PermissionRequest matches a Forbidden rule.
The evaluator returns Forbidden immediately, and because rule evaluation short-circuits, later rules are not checked.
Which hook would fire when the agent starts a new session?
SessionStart.
A test failure is hard to read because it compares structs field by field. What assertion style should Lamark tests prefer?
Prefer deep equality with `pretty_assertions::assert_eq` so the diff is clearer and the whole object is compared at once.
What is the cadence of the Curator background agent?
Every 7 days.
A team is running Lamark on a single host and wants a production sandbox backend. Which in-tree backend fits best?
`docker`.
You inspect a bundle and only see `manifest.json` and `trace.jsonl`. What directory should also exist?
A `payloads/` directory.
What is the Python CLI entry point for the training pipeline?
`lamark-train`.
What is lamark-gateway responsible for in Lamark?
lamark-gateway is the long-running process that wraps the agent for messaging platforms. It provides adapters for Telegram, Slack, and Discord, using a platform-agnostic gateway protocol.
A teammate says Lamark’s knowledge-base is part of the Rust workspace. Correct them.
Incorrect: the knowledge-base is a separate sibling Kotlin/Spring project, not part of the Rust workspace.
What does the offline reducer produce from a trace bundle?
It produces state.json and conversation.jsonl.
Name the provider implementations mentioned in the Lamark spec and say how they differ.

Lamark calls out LocalOpenAICompat for vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, SGLang, and LM Studio; AnthropicCompat for Anthropic-style APIs with cache_control breakpoints; and Bedrock for AWS Bedrock. They differ by backend API behavior, not by agent logic.
What is the difference between a plugin candidate and an in-tree sandbox backend in Lamark?
An in-tree backend is shipped and implemented inside Lamark now; a plugin candidate like Modal or Daytona is considered for future extensibility but is not part of the in-tree set described here.
What is the difference between nightly SFT and weekly DPO in Lamark?
Nightly SFT trains on the blended conversation dataset to improve the model's behavior. Weekly DPO trains from preference pairs instead of plain supervised examples.
Compare Allow, Prompt, and Forbidden in Lamark's policy DSL.
Allow permits the action, Prompt asks for approval, and Forbidden blocks it.
Which workspace should you run `just fmt`, `just fix -p <crate>`, and `just test -p lamark-<name>` from?
Run those commands from the `agent/` workspace.
Which hook events are tied to file and background workflow changes?
FileChanged and CuratorRun.
A developer wants Lamark to use tools from another app that already speaks MCP. What integration is this?
Lamark should act as an MCP client and connect to that third-party MCP server.
How do you format the Rust workspace from the Lamark agent directory?
From `agent/`, run `just fmt`.
Which tier is verified in v0.1 alpha, and which tiers are still experimental?
Tier S is verified. Tiers M, L, and XS are experimental.
Which hook event would you expect when a watched file changes?
FileChanged.
Is Lamark a cloud-only product?
No. Lamark is built to run locally on personal hardware first, with optional support for connecting to an endpoint you already operate or starting with a cloud provider during setup.
Review this claim: 'Lamark loads bundled skills before user skills.' Is it correct?
No. Lamark loads project skills first, then user skills, then bundled skills.
Write a concise code-review comment for this design: 'The gateway should call internal turn methods directly for lower latency.'

Reject this. Lamark uses the Op/Event queue boundary so all inputs go through the submit queue and all outputs are emitted as Events. Direct calls would bypass the shared stream used by tracing, TUI, and adapters.
List four event kinds that can appear in a Lamark trace bundle.
`RolloutStarted`, `InferenceStarted`, `ToolCallStarted`, and `ToolCallEnded`.
What does `lamark-sandbox` own?
`lamark-sandbox` owns the `Sandbox` trait and its backends.
What should Lamark do if cache strategy is set to off?
It should not use any prompt caching strategy.
Fill in the blank: callers submit ______, and the turn loop emits ______.
Ops, Events.
When writing a Lamark test, should I compare a whole returned object or assert its fields one by one?
Prefer deep equality on the whole object. Avoid field-by-field assertions unless there is a specific reason.
What is the practical role of base_url in Lamark provider config?
It tells Lamark which endpoint to send model requests to, especially for OpenAI-compatible local servers.
What endpoint does Lamark use to retrieve memory during a conversation?
GET /memory/search.
A patch adds `eprintln!` inside a sandbox backend because it only affects debugging. Is that consistent with Lamark rules?
No. Lamark layer crates must not log with `println!` or `eprintln!`; they should use `tracing`.
Write a one-line summary of Lamark's sandbox architecture.
Lamark uses a Sandbox trait to abstract execution across local, docker, ssh, and kubernetes backends, with optional plugin backends later.
Explain what nightly SFT does in Lamark.
Nightly SFT fine-tunes the base model on the latest curated conversation traces using LoRA. It is the daily update step that turns recent user interactions into style and behavior changes.
How do you run the first-time setup wizard?
Run `lamark setup`.
What combination of settings does Lamark use for practical DGX Spark LoRA training of Qwen3.6 MoE?
bf16 LoRA, frozen MoE router, ZeRO-2, `torchao>=0.16.0`, and `--no-build-isolation` for `mamba-ssm`/`causal-conv1d`.
Is it okay to mutate process environment variables in Lamark tests?
No. Avoid mutating the process environment in tests.
Explain the relationship between lamark setup and lamark switch-base.
lamark setup is the interactive first-time wizard that chooses how Lamark gets its model. lamark switch-base changes the default base model later without rerunning the whole setup flow.
A callback needs to reject a tool call before it runs. Which hook should it attach to?
PreToolUse, because that is the pre-execution interception point for tool usage.
What happens when Lamark tries to write memory facts and the knowledge-base is down?
Writes are fire-and-forget with SQLite spooling, so Lamark records the data locally and retries later instead of blocking the agent.
If a rule matches a shell command, does Lamark keep evaluating later rules?
No. The evaluator short-circuits on the first match.
What ZeRO stage should Lamark use for Qwen3.6 MoE LoRA training, and what stage should it avoid?
Use ZeRO-2 and avoid ZeRO-3.
What should be synced to knowledge-base when a session ends?
The reduced trace bundle data from the session should be synced to knowledge-base at session end.
A developer wants to react to denied actions and stop execution immediately. Which event and behavior matter most?
`PermissionDenied`, with deny-short-circuit behavior.
What are the two ACP pieces mentioned in the spec?
The ACP registry and the ACP adapter.
Why is the gateway protocol described as platform-agnostic?
Because the core gateway protocol is not tied to any one chat platform. Platform-specific behavior lives in adapters, so new messaging systems can plug into the same process shape.
What is ACP in Lamark?
ACP is the Agent Communication Protocol integration. Lamark includes an ACP registry and adapter so it can call other agents and be called by them.
Which subcommand should you use to change the default base model?
Use `lamark switch-base <model>`.
List Lamark's four memory layers and what each stores.

L1 identity stores "I am Lamark" in the chat template config; L2 episodic memory stores facts like "user likes blue" via Hermes memory and RAG retrieval; L3 knowledge edits stores high-priority facts as model-weight changes; L4 style/voice stores how the user writes via LoRA fine-tuning on user turns.
Write a one-sentence explanation of why Lamark uses a shared event stream.
Lamark uses a shared event stream so the trace recorder, gateway adapters, and TUI all observe the same canonical turn history emitted by the agent core.
Fill in the blank: Lamark uses __________________ for vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, SGLang, and LM Studio backends.
LocalOpenAICompat
Which crate defines the sandbox abstraction and its backends?
`lamark-sandbox` owns the `Sandbox` trait and the sandbox backends.
What should you do if a package install for `mamba-ssm` succeeds only when build isolation is disabled?
Keep the `--no-build-isolation` install path for that package.
Write a blunt correction for someone who says Lamark is just another cloud AI platform.
No: Lamark is a local, open-source AI agent meant to run on your own hardware. It is not a cloud-first platform.
List the three setup branches in the exact order Lamark presents them.
Local, Existing endpoint, Cloud-first.
Fill in the blank: If no rule matches a shell or write tool, the evaluator returns ________.
Decision::Prompt.
Fill in the blank: On DGX Spark, Lamark uses bf16 LoRA only; it does not use __________ for MoE training.
bitsandbytes QLoRA
What mechanism is planned for L3 knowledge edits?
L3 knowledge edits are planned to use ROME-style rank-1 surgery, applied nightly, to write high-priority facts into the model weights.
A callback needs to observe the result after a tool finishes. Which hook should it attach to?
PostToolUse.
How should Lamark handle a broken NGC auth flow when setting up the DGX Spark training container?
Use the `pytorch:26.01-py3` fallback container instead.
A user says, 'Lamark is basically AutoGPT.' Correct them.
Wrong. Lamark is its own open-source Rust agent runtime with layered memory, training, and trace infrastructure. It is not AutoGPT.
Which hook events are most directly tied to tool execution?
PreToolUse and PostToolUse.
A reviewer sees hard-coded logic choosing between vLLM and Anthropic in the Rust code. Is that aligned with Lamark's design?
No. Provider selection belongs in config, with the binary wiring the chosen ModelProvider implementation.
When a Lamark test compares two complex config values, what assertion strategy is preferred?
Use deep equality with `pretty_assertions::assert_eq` rather than comparing individual fields separately.
Complete the sentence: Lamark skill discovery starts in .lamark/skills/ and then falls back to ______ and ______.
~/.lamark/skills/ and bundled skills
Why does the policy evaluator short-circuit?
To stop at the first matching rule and avoid evaluating later rules once a decision is already determined.
What does the lamark-* naming convention mean in this repository?
Every Rust crate in the workspace is prefixed with `lamark-`, like `lamark-core`, `lamark-providers`, and `lamark-trace`.
Explain how Lamark uses the policy DSL to control shell and write-class tools.

Shell and write-class tools emit a PermissionRequest before they run. The policy evaluator checks the request against the declarative rules in agent/crates/lamark/policy.toml and returns Allow, Prompt, or Forbidden.
A test for a model provider needs to assert a JSON response body and headers from a mocked server. What library should it use?
Use `wiremock` to mock the HTTP server and assert the provider behavior against it.
What file in the trace bundle would you inspect first to understand the bundle metadata?
`manifest.json`.
Why does Lamark separate request submission from event emission?
To keep control flow explicit. Submission expresses intent, while emission reports outcomes. That separation makes tracing, routing, and UI rendering consistent across the system.

Rewrite this call to follow Lamark's argument-comment convention:

```rust
retry_request(None, true, 3);
```

Use comments before the opaque literals:

```rust
retry_request(/*timeout=*/ None, /*verbose=*/ true, /*attempts=*/ 3);
```

Refactor this code to follow Lamark's preference for inline `format!` args:

```rust
let msg = format!("failed to load {} from {}", name, source);
```

Rewrite it as:

```rust
let msg = format!("failed to load {name} from {source}");
```
Why do `mamba-ssm` and `causal-conv1d` need `--no-build-isolation` in this project?
That is the required install mode for the DGX Spark setup in Lamark.
Give the current status of Lamark and the hardware it has been verified on.
Lamark is alpha. v0.1.0-alpha.0 is verified on two independent DGX Spark hosts, and it has not yet been tested on consumer NVIDIA GPUs in the README’s verified status.
What format is conversation.jsonl expected to use after reduction?
Nemotron-Agentic-v1 format.
What should a Lamark regression test look like if I want to guard against a bug in chat output formatting?
It should start by reproducing the bad formatting as a failing test, then pass after the fix, ideally as an insta snapshot test if the output is user-visible.
When does Lamark run merge-and-unload plus requantize?
Monthly.
What is the relationship between Lamark and the user’s hardware?
Lamark is built to run on personal hardware, with setup choosing an appropriate model for the detected tier.
How can you change the default base model after setup?
Run `lamark switch-base <model>`.
What is the output of a monthly merge-and-unload step in Lamark?
A merged adapter that has been folded into the base model, followed by requantization for deployment.
Give a concise architecture summary of Lamark.

Lamark is a Rust local agent runtime backed by a separate Kotlin knowledge-base for durable storage and a Python training pipeline for overnight learning, with the pieces connected by files and HTTP rather than shared process memory.
If someone asks whether Lamark can be both a provider and consumer of external interfaces, how should you answer based on the spec?
Yes. It can consume third-party MCP servers as a client and expose tools as an MCP server; it also supports ACP for agent-to-agent calls.
List the Lamark hook event discriminators mentioned in the spec excerpt.

`PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PermissionRequest`, `PermissionDenied`, `PermissionGranted`, `SessionStart`, `FileChanged`, `GatewayMessageIn`, `GatewayMessageOut`, `SkillInvoked`, `CuratorRun`.
What mechanism does Lamark use for episodic memory today?
L2 episodic memory uses the Hermes memory tool with RAG retrieval, updating every turn.
How should a new consumer be integrated with Lamark's turn loop?
It should subscribe to the event queue and process emitted Events, not call into the agent core directly. That keeps it aligned with the recorder, gateway adapters, and TUI.
Complete the sentence: Every shell- and write-class tool in Lamark fires a _______.
PermissionRequest.
A build of `causal-conv1d` fails during Lamark training. What fix should you try first?
Re-run the install with `--no-build-isolation`.
A developer proposes QLoRA because it's more memory efficient. How should you respond for Lamark on DGX Spark?
Reject that for this setup. Use bf16 LoRA instead, because bitsandbytes QLoRA was confirmed to OOM at 4% for the MoE model.

Lamark avoids ambiguous bool parameters. How should this API be redesigned?

fn save_trace(path: &Path, compressed: bool) -> Result<()>;
In a Lamark provider test, I want to fake a response from an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. What should I use?
Use `wiremock` to stub the HTTP endpoint and return the response your provider expects.
List the memory providers Lamark supports in the current design.
Lamark includes the knowledge-base default provider, Honcho for dialectic user modeling, Mem0, Hindsight, and SQLite as a local fallback.
In Lamark, which assertion style is preferred over plain `assert_eq!` for easier debugging?
`pretty_assertions::assert_eq`.
Which knowledge-base endpoint does Lamark use to write memory facts?
Lamark writes memory facts with POST /memory/facts.
Name the top-level event that starts a rollout trace bundle.
RolloutStarted.
From the `agent/` workspace, how do you format the Rust codebase?
Run `just fmt`.
Write a short explanation of why SQ/EQ is better than letting every subsystem observe different internal signals.

Lamark uses SQ/EQ so all subsystems observe one canonical event stream. Different internal signals would drift apart and create inconsistent behavior. One queue in, one stream out keeps tracing, adapters, and UI aligned.
What does `lamark chat` do?
It opens the interactive REPL for talking to Lamark.
Fill in the blank: Lamark stores memory facts with ________ and searches them with ________.
Lamark stores memory facts with POST /memory/facts and searches them with GET /memory/search.
Why does Lamark prefer `pretty_assertions::assert_eq` in tests?
Because it gives clearer diffs when assertions fail, especially for structured values and large outputs.
How does Lamark represent the session event stream before reduction?
As line-delimited JSON events in `trace.jsonl`.
Write a short description that would help someone avoid search-engine confusion.

Lamark is the Rust-based local AI agent project from Merocle, not the unrelated companies or products that share similar names. It runs on personal hardware, learns over time, and is currently in alpha.
How would you describe the relationship between Lamark and the knowledge-base in one sentence?

Lamark’s Rust runtime uses the Kotlin knowledge-base as the canonical store for persistent data, while the knowledge-base exposes HTTP endpoints for traces, memory, datasets, skills, eval sets, and adapter lineage.
Which crate should you look at if you need to understand how Lamark talks to external memory providers?
`lamark-memory`.
On DGX Spark, which container should you use as the fallback if the NGC training image cannot be pulled because of auth issues?
Use the `pytorch:26.01-py3` container as the fallback.
Which sandbox backend is the dev default in Lamark, and which backend is the multi-tenant production default?
Local is the dev default. Kubernetes is the multi-tenant production default.
What is the purpose of L4 style/voice?
L4 learns the user's writing style through LoRA fine-tuning on user turns, typically after about 1000 turns.

In Lamark Rust code, how should this be rewritten to satisfy the format! convention?

let msg = format!("training {} finished for {}", run_id, user_name);

Use inline format args:

let msg = format!("training {run_id} finished for {user_name}");
Write the correct testing workflow for a Lamark bug fix.
First write a regression test that fails, then implement the fix, and finally rerun until the test turns green.
In one sentence, describe the policy DSL in agent/crates/lamark/policy.toml.
It is a declarative Allow|Prompt|Forbidden rule language for tool and command permissions.
Write the Lamark training pipeline as a concise checklist.

Collect traces, redact sensitive content, transform into training records, curate samples, run quality checks, blend the dataset, train with SFT-LoRA, evaluate, run the forgetting-probe, then promote or rollback.
Summarize Lamark's architecture in two bullets.

- Rust runtime: the live agent, CLI, and orchestration layer.
- Kotlin knowledge-base plus Python training pipeline: knowledge-base stores canonical persistent data over HTTP, and the Python pipeline uses that data for scheduled retraining.
Why is Lamark’s learning described as Lamarckian?
Because the system is designed so traits learned during interaction can be incorporated into the next generation of model weights, rather than only being retrieved from memory.
What does the context_length config field control?
It sets the model context window size Lamark should use for the selected provider.
In one sentence, what is Lamark?
Lamark is an open-source, locally hosted personal AI agent written in Rust that runs on your own hardware and learns about you over time through fine-tuning.
What does the ACP adapter enable?
It enables Lamark to participate in Agent Communication Protocol interactions with other agents.
I found a regression in Lamark. Should I write the test first or after the fix?
Write the regression test first. Follow RED/GREEN discipline: reproduce the bug with a failing test, then fix it until the test passes.
Describe the end-to-end flow for a Lamark rollout trace from capture to persistent storage.

Lamark writes the session into `~/.lamark/traces/<rollout_id>/` as `manifest.json`, `trace.jsonl`, and `payloads/`; the offline reducer then generates `state.json` and `conversation.jsonl` in Nemotron-Agentic-v1 format; on session end, the reduced data is synced to knowledge-base.
Which event kinds are explicitly mentioned for inference lifecycle tracing?
InferenceStarted, InferenceCompleted, InferenceFailed, and InferenceCancelled.

This Lamark code uses a closure where a method reference is preferred. Rewrite it:

```rust
let names: Vec<String> = users.iter().map(|user| user.name.clone()).collect();
```

Use the method reference:

```rust
let names: Vec<String> = users.iter().map(|user| user.name.clone()).collect();
```
What is the role of the `payloads/` directory in a Lamark trace bundle?
It stores attached payload data for the trace bundle.
Write the shortest correct answer to: “What provider type should I use for llama.cpp in Lamark?”
LocalOpenAICompat.
What happens on session end in Lamark with respect to knowledge-base?
Lamark syncs the session data to `knowledge-base` on session end.
What is the role of knowledge-base in Lamark's training loop if the Python pipeline does the actual training?
knowledge-base stores the canonical persistent artifacts: datasets, adapter metadata, and lifecycle events. The Python pipeline prepares and trains, then posts the results back to knowledge-base.
What is the policy evaluator’s behavior with a non-matching tool pattern?
It continues checking rules until one matches; if none match, the default is Decision::Prompt.
Compare the default sandbox setting for dev and production.
Dev defaults to `local`. Production defaults to `kubernetes`.
What does 'no direct injection' mean in the context of Lamark's agent core?
It means external code should not push state changes straight into the core. Instead, everything must go through submitted Ops so the turn loop can process them and emit Events in a controlled way.
Is Lamark cloud-first?

No. Lamark is local-first. The installer defers model choice until `lamark setup`, where you choose local hardware, an existing endpoint, or a cloud-first path, but the project’s core identity is a personal agent that runs on your own hardware.
Which Kubernetes setting determines how long Lamark waits before giving up on a pending sandbox?
`pending_timeout` determines how long Lamark waits for a pending sandbox.
Why does the Docker backend have egress controls in Lamark?
Because the sandbox design includes Docker egress options of none, model-provider-only, and allowlist, so network access can be restricted to match the deployment policy.
Why is the event queue the right place for consumers like the recorder and UI to listen?
Because it exposes the ordered stream of what the turn loop actually did. That makes downstream systems reactive, consistent, and aligned with the core execution path.
Why is the Allow / Prompt / Forbidden DSL useful in Lamark?
It lets the agent make per-command and per-tool permission decisions declaratively, without hardcoding policy logic in the runtime.
What does GET /memory/search provide that raw fact storage does not?
It lets Lamark retrieve memory by query instead of only writing facts, so the agent can look up relevant stored user information during conversation.
Fill in the blank: Lamark’s provider selection is driven by ______, not by changing the agent code.
config
In one sentence, explain what lamark-gateway is responsible for.
lamark-gateway is the long-running process that wraps the agent for messaging platforms like Telegram, Slack, and Discord.
Review this registry shape: `{ name, description, aliases, type, load }`. What is missing for Lamark's slash-command registry?
Nothing from the required shape is missing; `load()` is the lazy loader function.
Name the core implementation language and the project’s starting point.
Lamark is written in Rust from day one, with a Python training pipeline for learning.
What happens when Lamark wants to change how it writes to match a user?
That is an L4 style/voice update. The project uses LoRA fine-tuning on user turns so the writing style becomes part of the next generation of weights.
List the main files in a Lamark trace bundle and say what each one is for.
`manifest.json` describes the bundle, `trace.jsonl` stores the append-only event stream, and `payloads/` holds large attached artifacts referenced by events.
What does `lamark-memory` own?
`lamark-memory` owns the memory trait and memory providers.
Which sandbox backend is the dev default in Lamark, and which one is the production default for multi-tenant deployments?
`local` is the dev default backend. `kubernetes` is the production default for multi-tenant deployments.
What knowledge-base endpoint stores reduced training datasets?
POST /knowledge/datasets
Why does Lamark spool memory writes to SQLite instead of waiting indefinitely for knowledge-base?
Because memory writes are intended to be asynchronous and non-blocking. SQLite spooling preserves the write locally while Lamark keeps responding, and the KB timeout is only 5 seconds.
What does the `version` field in a Lamark skill frontmatter identify?
The skill version.
Is Lamark the same thing as LangChain?
No. Lamark is a self-improving local AI agent runtime and training pipeline; LangChain is a separate framework. Lamark is its own project, written in Rust with a Python learning pipeline.
Review this snippet: `std::process::exit(1);` inside a library crate. What is wrong with it?
It violates the process-control rule. Library layers must return `Result`; the binary handles exit codes.
Explain how the policy DSL classifies actions for shell- and write-class tools.
Shell- and write-class tools fire a PermissionRequest, and the policy evaluator resolves it with Allow, Prompt, or Forbidden rules.
What is the Lamark-preferred way to express opaque positional literals in a function call?
Use an exact `/*param_name*/` comment before the literal, especially for `None`, booleans, and numeric literals.
Explain the SQ/EQ pattern in one sentence.
Lamark uses a submit queue for incoming Ops and an event queue for outgoing Events so all agent activity is funneled through one turn loop and observed consistently by every consumer.
Name the backend that is intended for single-host production, and the backend intended for multi-tenant production.
Docker is for single-host production. Kubernetes is for multi-tenant production.
When is the argument-comment convention used in Lamark?

When you cannot change an API that takes opaque positional literals, such as booleans, `None`, or numeric literals. Write comments like `foo(/*force*/ true)` or `bar(/*timeout_ms*/ 30)` to make the call site readable.
Which crate owns memory abstractions and providers such as Honcho, Mem0, and Hindsight?
`lamark-memory` owns the memory trait and the memory providers, including Honcho, Mem0, and Hindsight.
A user wants to run Lamark against an endpoint they already operate. Which setup branch should they choose?
Existing endpoint.
What should a gateway adapter do when a platform message arrives in Lamark?
Convert the external message into an Op and submit it to the agent's submit queue. It should not call into the agent core directly, because the turn loop must remain the single execution path.
What is the role of the curate stage in the nightly pipeline?
Curate filters and organizes the transformed data into a training-ready set before quality checks and blending.
What is the role of command and tool patterns in policy.toml?
They let policy rules match specific shell commands or tool names so the evaluator can apply Allow, Prompt, or Forbidden decisions.
Which crate owns the `ModelProvider` trait implementations?
`lamark-providers` owns the `ModelProvider` implementations.
In Lamark, why is it a problem to add many one-off helpers just to shorten a single function?
It adds indirection without reuse. Lamark prefers keeping code direct unless extraction improves clarity, reuse, or ownership of related tests and docs.
In one sentence, how does Lamark handle a slow knowledge-base write path?
It waits up to 5 seconds, then switches to fire-and-forget behavior and spools the write into SQLite.
Lamark targets what approximate module size, and what should you do if a file grows too large?
Aim for under 500 LoC per module. If a file approaches around 800 LoC, split the functionality into a new module instead of letting it grow.
What Lamark sandbox setting would you use to cap how long a Kubernetes sandbox lives?
lifetime_seconds.
Describe Lamark without mentioning any unrelated AI buzzwords.
Lamark is an open-source, locally hosted AI agent in Rust that stores context, captures traces, and retrains itself from user interactions on personal hardware.
